title: WISHING ON SIGNALS
style:
Style: Acoustic + synth, nostalgic, emotional build

(Inspired by “Wish You Were Here” feeling — NOT copying lyrics)
lyrics:
[Intro — acoustic guitar + synth drone]

(radio tuning… click…)

[Verse 1]

Calling through the air tonight
Searching for a human sign
Every frequency I try
Still hoping you reply

[Verse 2]

Static dancing in my head
All the things we never said
Sending prayers through space
Trying to reach your face

[Pre-Chorus]

If you hear me now
Send a sound

[Chorus]

I’m wishing on signals
Across the sky
Looking for pieces
Of you and I

If you’re out there
Somewhere near
I’m wishing you were here

[Bridge — spoken + echo]

“Do you hear me…
Do you feel me…”

[Final Chorus]
[Outro — fade into radio noise]
